transcript: I think a combination of morality, technology, and sustainability is truly what would mark a utopia. This framework would depend on the basis of people being good, but with some technological help to rebuild a more innovative but sustainable society. I think that the tech would have limits so that it wouldn't go too far. And I think that it would open up doors to so many things people could do, but with a foundation of morality and sustainability to make it impossible to create greedy, dangerous billionaires like we have now who are destroying our planet. I think the freedom to advance and create with a focus on being morally good is the way to go.
